name: Taj Dal View
tagline: Perched on Kralsangri hill offering panoramic vistas of Dal Lake and Zabarwan ranges.
shortDescription: Overlooking the placid waters of Dal Lake and framed by the majestic Zabarwan mountain range, Taj Dal View is the epitome of luxury hospitality in Srinagar with heated pool, fine dining, and Jiva spa.

name: The LaLit Grand Palace
tagline: The former royal residence of Maharaja Pratap Singh surrounded by century-old Chinar trees.
shortDescription: Built in 1910 by Maharaja Pratap Singh, The LaLit Grand Palace Srinagar is a royal heritage masterpiece overlooking Dal Lake with palatial suites, heated indoor pool, and regal dining.

name: Sarovar Premiere
tagline: Sophisticated contemporary comfort, world-class dining and premium executive hospitality.
shortDescription: Conveniently positioned on the airport corridor in Srinagar, Sarovar Premiere offers refined five-star luxury with elegantly appointed rooms, wellness spa, and round-the-clock service.

name: WelcomHeritage
tagline: Curated heritage hospitality celebrating royal Kashmiri artistry, traditions and calm waters.
shortDescription: WelcomHeritage properties in Srinagar represent the pinnacle of Kashmiri cultural grandeur with hand-carved deodar woodwork, lakefront settings, royal butler service, and exquisite Wazwan.

name: Asian Park
tagline: Modern deluxe stay minutes from Dal Lake, Boulevard promenade and Mughal gardens.
shortDescription: Located in close proximity to Dal Lake and Srinagar's famous Mughal gardens, Asian Park Hotel blends modern elegance with traditional Kashmiri warmth and centrally heated rooms.

name: Namrose Resorts & Spa
tagline: A stylish lakeside sanctuary with restorative spa therapy and mountain view dining.
shortDescription: Set directly on Boulevard Road along Dal Lake, Namrose Resorts & Spa features chic designer interiors, scenic lakeside balcony rooms, full-body restorative therapies, and terrace dining.

name: Comrade Inn
tagline: Refined hospitality in the fashionable shopping and residential quarter of Rajbagh.
shortDescription: Comrade Inn is an esteemed 4-star boutique hotel located in Rajbagh, Srinagar's diplomatic heart. Offering premium sound-insulated guestrooms with individual climate controls and fine dining.

name: Ov Boutique
tagline: Contemporary minimalist aesthetics combined with thoughtful, intimate guest service.
shortDescription: Ov Boutique Hotel delivers a refreshingly contemporary experience in Srinagar with clean minimalist lines, cozy electric heating blankets, in-house coffee bar, and attentive staff.

name: Midtown Greens
tagline: Peaceful green gardens and comfortable family accommodations in the heart of Srinagar.
shortDescription: Tucked away in a tranquil residential pocket near the Tourist Reception Centre, Midtown Greens offers a serene garden sanctuary with spacious bedrooms, home-style meals, and helpful staff.

name: Pride Inn
tagline: Dependable comfort, spotless amenities and warm Kashmiri hospitality for every holiday.
shortDescription: Pride Inn is a trusted 3-star property recognized for its spotless hygiene, generous room dimensions, and polite staff, making it perfect for families seeking great value and warm hospitality.

name: The Khyber Himalayan Resorts & Spa
tagline: World-renowned Himalayan ski resort nestled 8,825 feet high with Apharwat panoramas.
shortDescription: Perched at 8,825 feet among virgin pine forests in Gulmarg, The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is India's most celebrated alpine luxury resort with ski-in access, heated indoor glass pool, and L'Occitane Spa.

name: Hilltop (Gulmarg)
tagline: Walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola with cozy alpine wood fireplaces.
shortDescription: Hotel Hilltop Gulmarg is ideally situated within walking distance of the Gulmarg Gondola base station. Featuring warm pine-paneled rooms, central heating, a roaring lobby fireplace, and mountain views.

name: Apple Tree Resorts
tagline: Surrounded by fragrant apple orchards and snow-clad foothills at the gateway to Gulmarg.
shortDescription: Located in the picturesque Tangmarg valley at the gateway to Gulmarg, Apple Tree Resorts offers cozy heated cottages surrounded by apple orchards, bonfire evenings, and hearty meals.

name: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Pine N Peak
tagline: Pahalgam's premier five-star sanctuary perched high on the pine-covered Rajwas plateau.
shortDescription: Perched atop the Rajwas plateau overlooking the Lidder River and snow-crested pine ridges, Welcomhotel Pine N Peak is Pahalgam's only branded 5-star resort blending timber architecture with luxury.

name: Mountnoor Sarovar Premiere
tagline: Lavish river-valley luxury framed by the rushing Lidder and cascading cedar hills.
shortDescription: Setting a new benchmark for five-star indulgence in Pahalgam, Mountnoor Sarovar Premiere features magnificent alpine architecture, temperature-controlled luxury suites, and Lidder river views.

name: The Walnut Creek
tagline: Elegant riverside getaway enveloped by ancient walnut trees and whispering pines.
shortDescription: The Walnut Creek is an enchanting 4-star boutique resort located on the riverbanks of Pahalgam. Offering cedar-clad rooms, private sitting verandas, Lidder river views, and evening lawn bonfires.

name: Black Pearl
tagline: Friendly hospitality and cozy rooms making Pahalgam's valleys accessible to all travellers.
shortDescription: Hotel Black Pearl offers dependable 3-star comfort in the scenic surroundings of Pahalgam with heated bedrooms, clean ensuite bathrooms, tasty meals, and close access to Betaab valley.

name: Houseboat Royal Star
tagline: Hand-carved cedar floating palace offering traditional Shikara crossings and lake living.
shortDescription: Moored on the calm waters of Dal Lake, Houseboat Royal Star provides an authentic Kashmiri heritage stay with walnut-wood carvings, chandeliers, sun-deck, and private Shikara ferry service.

name: Macot Houseboats
tagline: The jewel of tranquil Nigeen Lake celebrated for royal luxury and unmatched privacy.
shortDescription: Widely acclaimed as one of Kashmir's most prestigious luxury houseboat fleets, Mascot Houseboats is anchored on serene Nigeen Lake with palatial rooms, dedicated butler hospitality, and Wazwan dining.
